snippet.description:
How I Cleared UPSC Prelims 2026? In this exclusive session, Samiksha Arora shares her real UPSC Prelims 2026 experience, exam hall strategy, question-solving approach and mindset that helped her move forward in the Civil Services Examination.

Preparing for UPSC CSE 2027? This session will help you understand how to approach the actual UPSC Prelims examination, manage time effectively and make smarter decisions inside the examination hall.

- How to Attempt the UPSC Prelims Paper Effectively
- Real UPSC Prelims 2026 Exam Experience
- Complete Exam Hall Strategy
- Smart Question Selection Techniques
- Time Management During the Examination
- Accuracy vs Number of Attempts
- How to Handle Difficult and Confusing Questions
- Strategies to Avoid Negative Marking
- How to Maintain Focus Under Exam Pressure
- The Right Mindset for UPSC Prelims
- Important Lessons for Future UPSC Aspirants

Clearing UPSC Prelims is not just about knowledge. Your question selection, accuracy, time management and decision-making during the examination also play an important role.

Learn from Samiksha Arora's real examination experience and understand how to develop a practical approach for your upcoming UPSC Civil Services Examination.

- UPSC CSE 2027 Aspirants
- UPSC CSE 2028 Aspirants
- Students Preparing for UPSC Prelims
- First-Time UPSC Aspirants
- Aspirants Looking for Better Exam Hall Strategies

Watch till the end and take away valuable lessons for your UPSC preparation.
